title: Glue Up & Xero API Connector
description: An enterprise integration suite and Flask automation dashboard connecting Glue Up CRM with Xero Accounting. Automates financial invoice ledger synchronization, HMAC-SHA256 digest signing, OAuth2 token lifecycle management, CRM dormant contact auditing, and historical activity data export.
Highlights: Custom HMAC-SHA256 digest authentication client generating dynamic cryptographically-signed request headers with millisecond timestamp validation for Glue Up Open API v2
Seamless Xero Accounting integration via xero-python SDK featuring OAuth2 token exchange, automatic mid-sync token refresh, and duplicate invoice detection via reference keys
Financial reconciliation pipeline converting Glue Up final totals to tax-inclusive line items with dynamic GL chart of accounts code routing (codes 2004 and 2005)
CRM hygiene and dormant contact audit engine aggregating lifetime attendee histories across all historical organization events with enriched client-side Excel (.xlsx) export via SheetJS
Containerized multi-environment architecture with Docker Compose and Render web service deployment, secured via HTTP Basic Auth middleware and webhook signature verification
